title: Prove the selected PR6030 scalar instructions lift at every column mu…
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Every `SCALE`, `ADD` and `COPY` in the selected PR #6030 word acts by the same rational matrix at every column multiplicity `f ≥ 1`. The census is 18,404 `ADD`s, 861 `SCALE`s and 23 `COPY`s, each on one common chart, and every `COPY` writes an empty owned logical row. The 3,453 `MOVE`s are outside this implication.

This is a scoped proof of one implication of assumption `native_all_columns`. It is not a discharge of that assumption, not a scalar saving, and not a change to selected κ `781451/250000000`.

## Task and overlap

Base commit: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a` on canonical `CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds` main. Priority revision 8. Selected record κ `781451/250000000`.

Task card: `uniform-transfer-audit`. Scope status: **refined**. The card asks for one assumption ID and one quantified implication at the actual caller. This binds the scalar-instruction half of `native_all_columns` to the selected #6030 word. It does not treat #5625 row reentry or #5707 root-prefix lowering as a discharge of any of the five assumptions.

Session r92, item 5 of the ordered eligible list. The 19 October handoff index is already delivered. Later structured handoffs are excluded when the post is DONE, a later merged result answers them, or the canonical artifact is an open PR, including the H25 requests on #6321, #6326, #6328, #6332 and #6335 and the 2 November review artifacts #6355, #6357, #6359, #6360, #6361, #6376, #6378 and #6396. Unexpired claims do not cover this word's scalar events. Work already delivered by this account is excluded. The revision-8 next-decision table then supplies six rows, and unnamed catalogue cards follow. Item 5 is the all-size row. Inside that row, #5837, #6293 and #6522 are different implications.

Nearest work:

- unpaidmoon #5837, `research/native-scalar-chart-lift`: the same lemmas for the older #5599 word. Its proof says a different word still has to be proved on its own hypothesis.
- unpaidmoon #6293, `research/move-chart-phase-power`: `MOVE` phase `i^{p f}` on this #6030 word. Not the scalar events.
- unpaidmoon #6522: the `precision_tape` envelope exponent. A different assumption.
- JosieElliston, `research/p104-6030-independent-audit`: width-1 endpoint replay, including common charts and empty `COPY`s. It does not state the all-`f` scalar proposition.
- Open PR #6538 and #6537: scaled-fusion native columns and a 74-gate output correction on a different word. Not this caller.

Open-PR overlap at 2026-11-03T13:29:40Z covered 572 open PR bodies. No open PR states this census. The discussion refresh returned HTTP 502. Comments on #1166 from 2026-10-24 through 2026-11-03 were read directly and do not claim these scalar events.

## Validation

CPython 3.12.3, standard library, Linux. From the repository root:

```sh
python3 -B research/pr6030-scalar-chart-lift/verify.py
python3 -O -B research/pr6030-scalar-chart-lift/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr6030-scalar-chart-lift
python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
```

Both verifier modes and the registered replay printed

```text
PASS_PR6030_SCALAR_CHART_LIFT adds=18404 scales=861 copies=23 moves=3453 inits=31 clears=31 common_chart_violations=0 copy_into_empty=23 peak_owned=13 owned_fields=29 public=770 events=22803 phase_width2_only=true no_new_kappa=true
```

The package command printed `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` with outcome `partial`. `check_research_commit.py` printed `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES` at `c279bbc47120502163897715a29b046f43c2cc31`.

The baseline command printed `PASS_RESEARCH_BASELINE_BINDINGS_ONLY` with selected κ `781451/250000000`. That is binding orientation only.

The failure controls are in the verifier: a cross-chart `ADD`, a stale frame after `MOVE`, a zero coefficient, a `COPY` into a nonempty owned row, and a one-step retag of the first selected `ADD` are rejected. The phase-chart trap matches the width-free replay at width 2 and misses it at widths 1 and 3.

Not run: `make frontier6030-verify`, the primary native replay, Lean, and Docker. `MOVE` operators, spectators, adapters and the fixed-tape tariff are not proved.

## Credit

The selected word is DreamingOfClouds' PR #6030. The chart convention and the scalar induction are the ones recorded for the older #5599 word in `research/native-scalar-chart-lift` (unpaidmoon, PR #5837). #6293 records the `MOVE` phase factor on this word. The width-1 endpoint replay is JosieElliston's `research/p104-6030-independent-audit`. The selected review is Douglas Colkitt's `docs/research/pr-intake-evidence/pr6030-audit/PROOF-REVIEW.md`, with OpenAI Codex assistance. #5442 (Mark / Matarener) is the group-algebra half for the older #5413 caller.

Prepared by unpaidmoon with substantial Cursor Grok assistance. Apache-2.0.

## Open next questions

1. Do the 3,453 `MOVE`s of this word equal `(chart_b^{-1} chart_a)^{(⊗)f}` as group elements, including absolute phase `i^{p f}`? The first step is one lowered recipe with `p ≠ 0` against `U^{(⊗)f}`. Blocked because the primary native payload is not an input here, and #6293 leaves that joint recipe open.
2. Does the empty-`COPY` chart identity survive the retained tape and erasure model at width `f`? The first step is one `INIT`/`COPY`/`CLEAR` triple in that model. Blocked by `owned_erasure` and `precision_tape`.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The revision-8 table still names the older #5599 exponent in its opening paragraph, while `certificates/selected-result.json` selects PR6030 at `781451/250000000`. Reading the selected record before the priority prose avoided proving the scalar half on the stale word. A link to discussion #1200 is enough.
